name: Choco Millet Muesli
ingredients_raw: MULTIGRAIN MIX (69.1%) WHEAT (20.3%), RICE (18.6%), CORN GRITS & CORN MEAL (9.6%), RAGI FLOUR (6.7%), ROLLED BARLEY (5%), ROLLED OATS (5%), JOWAR FLOUR (4.5%, SUGAR, CANDIED & DRY FRUITS & SEEDS (9%) (CANDIED CRANBERRIES (3%), BLACK CURRANTS (3%), PUMPKIN SEEDS (3%), OLIGOFRUCTOSE, WHEAT BRAN, COCOA SOLIDS (14%), CEREAL EXTRACT, IODIZED SALT, FLAVOURS (NATURE IDENTICAL AND ARTIFICIAL (CARAMEL COLOUR (INS 1500), VITAMINS, ANTIOXIDANT INS 3076) AND MINERAL.
